brief_summary: This trial tests whether Fuling Yunhua Granules and Dihuang Baoyuan Granules, given in sequence with or without continued metformin, lower blood sugar in adults with type 2 diabetes already taking metformin. It will also assess their safety.
brief_title: Fuling Yunhua Granules and Dihuang Baoyuan Granules in Adults With Type 2 Diabetes and Inadequate Glycemic Control on Metformin Therapy

lead_sponsor.name: Beijing Supreme Life Pharmaceutical Technology Co., Ltd.

official_title: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Phase II Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Fuling Yunhua Granules and Dihuang Baoyuan Granules in Combination With Metformin in Adult Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus and Inadequate Glycemic Control on Metformin Therapy

primary_outcomes.measure: Change from Baseline in Glycated Hemoglobin (HbA1c) at Week 24
